info.name: Atlassian Admin Account Screen Schemes API

params.name: screenSchemeId
params.description: The ID of the screen scheme.

items.docs:
Updates a screen scheme. Only screen schemes used in classic projects can be updated.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

params.name: screenSchemeId
params.description: The ID of the screen scheme.

items.docs:
Deletes a screen scheme. A screen scheme cannot be deleted if it is used in an issue type screen scheme.

Only screens schemes used in classic projects can be deleted.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

params.name: startAt
params.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

params.name: id
params.description: The list of screen scheme IDs. To include multiple IDs, provide an ampersand-separated list. For example, `id=10000&id=10001`.

params.name: expand
params.description: Use [expand](#expansion) include additional information in the response. This parameter accepts `issueTypeScreenSchemes` that, for each screen schemes, returns information about the issue type screen scheme the screen scheme is assigned to.

params.name: queryString
params.description: String used to perform a case-insensitive partial match with screen scheme name.

params.name: orderBy
params.description:
[Order](#ordering) the results by a field:

 *  `id` Sorts by screen scheme ID.
 *  `name` Sorts by screen scheme name.

items.docs:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of screen schemes.

Only screen schemes used in classic projects are returned.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).
